name: labs/nion-software__nionswift-instrumentation-kit
title: Nion STEM instrument (nion.device_kit.InstrumentDevice:Instrument)
intro: Nion STEM instrument (nion.device_kit.InstrumentDevice:Instrument), adapted from nion-software/nionswift-instrumentation-kit. It reads `beam_current_a`; sets `beam_voltage`, `defocus_m` and `energy_offset_ev`; runs `high_tension_off`. `high_tension_off`: remove the high tension: write the EHT control as 0 through the value manager; no input. A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.
